decks.notes: This Bant Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of cards to control the game, including counter spells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through efficient spells like Swords to Plowshares and Brainstorm. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provides additional threats that can help finish the game. With a mixture of control elements and proactive threats, this deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a combination of precision and strategy.

The deck revolves around using Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Narcomoeba, enabling a combo finish with Dread Return or Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes powerful interaction like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan while digging through the deck with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and the mana base is built to support the combo while also having access to key colors for the deck's spells.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition to slow down the opponent, and Stoneforge Mystic to search for crucial equipment, the deck can control the battlefield. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value with its blink effect. With a mix of disruptive and powerful creatures, this deck seeks to control the pace of the game while steadily building up its board presence to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Death & Taxes strategy to disrupt opponents while applying early pressure with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares for disruption, combined with efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Skyclave Apparition, this deck aims to control the board and quickly close out games. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Reanimate and Entomb allows for potential graveyard recursion and additional threats. The mana base is focused on consistency and disruption with Wasteland and Karakas to disrupt opponents' mana bases.

This deck focuses on putting together a specific sequence of cards to win the game in a single turn using the Doomsday combo. By carefully setting up the perfect pile of cards with Doomsday, the player can efficiently win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Quantum Riddler. The deck includes various cards for card draw, disruption, and mana acceleration to help set up the combo quickly and protect it from opponents. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to assemble the perfect combination of cards to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy powerful goblin creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategies with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. This aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Muxus, Goblin Grandee, while also providing mana acceleration with cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox. The inclusion of utility goblins like Stingscourger and Goblin Trashmaster helps the deck deal with threats from the opponent, while cards like Breeches, Eager Pillager and General Kreat, the Boltbringer provide additional value and reach.

The deck focuses on using lands as control elements, utilizing cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful threat. It also includes cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to ensure consistent land drops and maximize synergy with land-based spells. The deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy through land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Bojuka Bog, while also having access to utility lands like Karakas and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to further control the game. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through strategic land plays.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland while utilizing lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create powerful threats. It also utilizes Life from the Loam to ensure a steady stream of lands and Exploration to ramp up quickly. The inclusion of control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Maze of Ith help to control the board while the Urza's Saga enchantment provides additional value. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by efficiently managing its lands and disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom to generate massive card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfling to draw cards and protect your key pieces, along with disruption from cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, you can create a powerful and resilient combo engine. With support from cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Teferi, Time Raveler to tutor and protect your combo pieces, this deck aims to control the game and win through combo synergy.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures and spells by utilizing the combo card Show and Tell, which allows players to put a card from their hand onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to cheat out big threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Omniscience early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Veil of Summer for protection, as well as cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. Overall, the goal is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent with explosive plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Infect mechanic to deal damage quickly and efficiently, with a key emphasis on utilizing cards such as Berserk and Blazing Shoal to power up creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Cacophony Scamp. The inclusion of cards like Progenitus and Monstrous Rage allow for explosive plays and potential one-hit kills. The deck also includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Leyline of Resonance, ensuring that the combo can go off without disruption. Additionally, cards like Once Upon a Time and Legolas's Quick Reflexes provide consistency and flexibility in executing the combo. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly and efficiently bring out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The deck also includes ways to protect these creatures with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and win the game in a fast and explosive manner before the opponent can react effectively.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back to the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruption and protection with cards like Force of Will and Brazen Borrower. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures, taking advantage of the graveyard as a resource, while also having some control elements to protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to be fast and efficient, combining combo and reanimator strategies to create a powerful and versatile gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back to the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes countermagic like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disruption like Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand. The deck aims to establish a powerful board presence with creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty, while also utilizing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage. It can also control the opponent's resources with cards like Daze and Wasteland.

Utilizing a combination of fast mana, discard spells, and reanimation spells, this deck aims to quickly put powerful creatures into play from the graveyard, bypassing traditional resource costs. The deck focuses on reanimating high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. With a mix of disruptive cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to protect its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately racing to victory through explosive plays.
